labels.landing_clear_confirm:
Tetapkan semula ke skrin mula?

Memadam data bangunan dalam pelayar:
  • bangunan dalam cache
  • mana-mana adegan IFC yang anda lepaskan (tidak disimpan sebagai fail .db)
dan membawa anda kembali ke pilihan merah / biru.

Kekal: aplikasi yang dipasang + data luar talian, dan mana-mana .db yang anda simpan sendiri.

labels.tm_tt_locked: Dikunci: seret/ubah saiz/pautan dimatikan, garis masa masih bergerak secara langsung. Klik untuk membuka kunci suntingan.
labels.tm_tt_editing: Menyunting: seret untuk alih/ubah saiz, seret ke bar lain untuk memaut, dwiklik untuk suntingan bertaip. Klik untuk mengunci.

labels.tm_tt_p6_file: Import program Primavera P6 (.xer atau .xml/PMXML) atau MS Project XML (MSPDI) — guna pakai WBS, logik dan tarikhnya ke model ini. Mengikat tugas kepada elemen kekal langkah berasingan yang boleh disemak.
labels.tm_tt_autobind: Jika nama aktiviti membawa token BIM-Bind (@disiplin:KelasIfc[:tingkat]), selesaikannya terhadap model ini dan pra-ikat tugas kepada elemen semasa import — lelaran pertama yang boleh disemak, bukan tekaan.
labels.tm_tt_export_msp: Eksport jadual semasa (WBS, tarikh, kebergantungan) sebagai MS Project XML (MSPDI) — terus dibuka dalam Microsoft Project; boleh diimport semula di sini juga.
labels.tm_tt_export_pmxml: Eksport sebagai Primavera P6 PMXML (XML APIBusinessObjects) — format yang digunakan setiap laluan eksport P6 yang didokumenkan; boleh diimport semula di sini juga. Sesetengah medan (kod WBS, kod aktiviti peringkat EPS, tugasan sumber, kalendar global, garis dasar) tidak dibawa — P6 sendiri menggugurkan kebanyakannya semasa import antara DB.
labels.tm_tt_export_xer: Eksport sebagai Primavera XER — pertukaran P6 lama berpemisah tab, untuk pemasangan P6 yang masih memilihnya berbanding PMXML. Medan hilang yang sama seperti PMXML.

labels.ifcdef_IfcAirTerminal: An air terminal is a terminating or origination point for the transfer of air between distribution system(s) and one or more spaces. It can also be used for the transfer of air between adjacent spaces.
labels.ifcdef_IfcAlarm: An alarm is a device that signals the existence of a condition or situation that is outside the boundaries of normal expectation or that activates such a device.
labels.ifcdef_IfcBeam: An [[IfcBeam]] is typically a horizontal, or nearly horizontal, structural member that is capable of withstanding load primarily by resisting bending. It may also represent such a member from an architectural point of view. It is not required to be load bearing.
labels.ifcdef_IfcBuildingElementPart: [[IfcBuildingElementPart]] represents major components as subordinate parts of a building element. Typical usage examples include precast concrete sandwich walls, where the layers may have different geometry representations. In this case the layered material representation does not sufficiently describe the element. Each layer is represented by an own instance of the [[IfcBuildingElementPart]] with its own geometry description.
labels.ifcdef_IfcBuildingElementProxy: The [[IfcBuildingElementProxy]] is a proxy definition that provides the same functionality as subtypes of [[IfcBuiltElement]], but without having a predefined meaning of the special type of building element it represents.
labels.ifcdef_IfcCableCarrierFitting: A cable carrier fitting is a fitting that is placed at junction or transition in a cable carrier system.
labels.ifcdef_IfcCableCarrierSegment: A cable carrier segment is a flow segment that is specifically used to carry and support cabling.
labels.ifcdef_IfcColumn: An [[IfcColumn]] is a vertical structural or architectural member which often is aligned with a structural grid intersection. In most cases it represents a vertical, or nearly vertical, structural member that transmits, through compression, the weight of the structure above to other structural elements below. It may also represent such a member from an architectural point of view in which case it may represent a non load bearing element. Whether it is a structural load bearing element or a non-load bearing element is determined by the [[Pset_ColumnCommon]].[[LoadBearing]] property.
labels.ifcdef_IfcController: A controller is a device that monitors inputs and controls outputs within a building automation system.
labels.ifcdef_IfcCovering: A covering is an element which covers some part of another element and is fully dependent on that other element. The [[IfcCovering]] defines the occurrence of a covering type, that (if given) is expressed by the IfcCoveringType.
labels.ifcdef_IfcCurtainWall: A curtain wall is a wall of a building which is an assembly of components, hung from the edge of the floor/roof structure rather than bearing on a floor. Curtain wall is represented as a building element assembly and implemented as a subtype of [[IfcBuiltElement]] that uses an IfcRelAggregates relationship. A curtain wall is often external, but using [[Pset_CurtainWallCommon]].[[IsExternal]] can be used to define interior curtain walls.
labels.ifcdef_IfcDistributionControlElement: The distribution element [[IfcDistributionControlElement]] defines occurrence elements of a building automation control system that are used to impart control over elements of a distribution system.
labels.ifcdef_IfcDoor: The door is a built element that is predominately used to provide controlled access for people, goods, animals and vehicles. It includes constructions with hinged, pivoted, sliding, and additionally revolving and folding operations.
labels.ifcdef_IfcDuctFitting: A duct fitting is a junction or transition in a ducted flow distribution system or used to connect duct segments, resulting in changes in flow characteristics to the fluid such as direction and flow rate.
labels.ifcdef_IfcDuctSegment: A duct segment is used to typically join two sections of duct network.
labels.ifcdef_IfcElectricAppliance: An electric appliance is a device intended for consumer usage that is powered by electricity.
labels.ifcdef_IfcEnergyConversionDevice: The distribution flow element [[IfcEnergyConversionDevice]] defines the occurrence of a device used to perform energy conversion or heat transfer and typically participates in a flow distribution system. Its type is defined by IfcEnergyConversionDeviceType or its subtypes.
labels.ifcdef_IfcFireSuppressionTerminal: A fire suppression terminal has the purpose of delivering a fluid (gas or liquid) that will suppress a fire.
labels.ifcdef_IfcFlowController: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowController]] defines the occurrence of elements of a distribution system that are used to regulate flow through a distribution system. Examples include dampers, valves, switches, and relays. Its type is defined by IfcFlowControllerType or subtypes.
labels.ifcdef_IfcFlowFitting: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowFitting]] defines the occurrence of a junction or transition in a flow distribution system, such as an elbow or tee. Its type is defined by IfcFlowFittingType or its subtypes.
labels.ifcdef_IfcFlowMovingDevice: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowMovingDevice]] defines the occurrence of an apparatus used to distribute, circulate or perform conveyance of fluids, including liquids and gases (such as a pump or fan), and typically participates in a flow distribution system. Its type is defined by IfcFlowMovingDeviceType or its subtypes.
labels.ifcdef_IfcFlowSegment: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowSegment]] defines the occurrence of a segment of a flow distribution system.
labels.ifcdef_IfcFlowStorageDevice: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowStorageDevice]] defines the occurrence of a device that participates in a distribution system and is used for temporary storage (such as a tank). Its type is defined by IfcFlowStorageDeviceType or its subtypes.
labels.ifcdef_IfcFlowTerminal: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowTerminal]] defines the occurrence of a permanently attached element that acts as a terminus or beginning of a distribution system (such as an air outlet, drain, water closet, or sink). A terminal is typically a point at which a system interfaces with an external environment. Its type is defined by IfcFlowTerminalType or its subtypes.
labels.ifcdef_IfcFlowTreatmentDevice: The distribution flow element [[IfcFlowTreatmentDevice]] defines the occurrence of a device typically used to remove unwanted matter from a fluid, either liquid or gas, and typically participates in a flow distribution system. Its type is defined by IfcFlowTreatmentDeviceType or its subtypes.
labels.ifcdef_IfcFooting: A footing is a part of the foundation of a structure that spreads and transmits the load to the soil. A footing is also characterized as shallow foundation, where the loads are transferred to the ground near the surface.
labels.ifcdef_IfcFurnishingElement: A furnishing element is a generalization of all furniture related objects. Furnishing objects are characterized as being
labels.ifcdef_IfcFurniture: Furniture defines complete furnishings such as a table, desk, chair, or cabinet, which may or may not be permanently attached to a building structure.
labels.ifcdef_IfcLightFixture: A light fixture is a container that is designed for the purpose of housing one or more lamps and optionally devices that control, restrict or vary their emission.
labels.ifcdef_IfcMember: An [[IfcMember]] is a structural member designed to carry loads between or beyond points of support. It is not required to be load bearing. The orientation of the member (being horizontal, vertical or sloped) is not relevant to its definition (in contrary to [[IfcBeam]] and [[IfcColumn]]). An [[IfcMember]] represents a linear structural element from an architectural or structural modeling point of view and shall be used if it cannot be expressed more specifically as either an [[IfcBeam]] or an [[IfcColumn]].
labels.ifcdef_IfcOpeningElement: The opening element stands for opening, recess or chase, all reflecting voids. It represents a void within any element that has physical manifestation. Openings can be inserted into walls, slabs, beams, columns, or other elements.
labels.ifcdef_IfcPipeFitting: A pipe fitting is a junction or transition in a piping flow distribution system used to connect pipe segments, resulting in changes in flow characteristics to the fluid such as direction or flow rate.
labels.ifcdef_IfcPipeSegment: A pipe segment is used to typically join two sections of a piping network.
labels.ifcdef_IfcPlate: An [[IfcPlate]] is a planar and often flat part with constant thickness. A plate may carry loads between or beyond points of support, or provide stiffening. The location of the plate (being horizontal, vertical or sloped) is not relevant to its definition.
labels.ifcdef_IfcRailing: The railing is a frame assembly adjacent to human or vehicle circulation spaces and at some space boundaries where it is used in lieu of walls or to complement walls. Designed as an optional physical support, or to prevent injury or damage, either by falling or collision.
labels.ifcdef_IfcRamp: A ramp is a vertical passageway which provides a human or vehicle circulation link between one floor level and another floor level at a different elevation. It may include a landing as an intermediate floor slab. A ramp normally does not include steps.
labels.ifcdef_IfcRampFlight: A ramp comprises a single inclined segment, or several inclined segments that are connected by a horizontal segment, referred to as a landing. A ramp flight is the single inclined segment and part of the ramp construction. In case of single flight ramps, the ramp flight and the ramp are identical.
labels.ifcdef_IfcReinforcingBar: A reinforcing bar is usually made of steel with manufactured deformations in the surface, and used in concrete and masonry construction to provide additional strength. A single instance of this class may represent one or many of actual rebars, for example a row of rebars.
labels.ifcdef_IfcRoof: A roof is the covering of the top part of a building, it protects the building against the effects of weather.
labels.ifcdef_IfcSlab: A slab is a component of the construction that may enclose a space vertically. The slab may provide the lower support (floor) or upper construction (roof slab) in any space in a building.
labels.ifcdef_IfcStair: A stair is a vertical passageway allowing occupants to walk (step) from one floor level to another floor level at a different elevation. It may include a landing as an intermediate floor slab.
labels.ifcdef_IfcStairFlight: A stair flight is an assembly of building components in a single 'run' of stair steps (not interrupted by a landing). The stair steps and any stringers are included in the stair flight. A winder is also regarded a part of a stair flight.
labels.ifcdef_IfcSwitchingDevice: A switch is used in a cable distribution system (electrical circuit) to control or modulate the flow of electricity.
labels.ifcdef_IfcSystemFurnitureElement: A system furniture element defines components of modular furniture which are not directly placed in a building structure but aggregated inside furniture.
labels.ifcdef_IfcTransportElement: A transport element is a generalization of all transport related objects that move people, animals or goods within a Facility. The [[IfcTransportElement]] defines the occurrence of a transport element, that (if given), is expressed by the IfcTransportElementType.
labels.ifcdef_IfcValve: A valve is used in a building services piping distribution system to control or modulate the flow of the fluid.
labels.ifcdef_IfcWall: The wall represents a vertical construction that may bound or subdivide spaces. Wall are usually vertical, or nearly vertical, planar elements, often designed to bear structural loads. A wall is however not required to be load bearing.
labels.ifcdef_IfcWindow: The window is a building element that is predominately used to provide natural light and fresh air. It includes vertical opening but also horizontal opening such as skylights or light domes. It includes constructions with swinging, pivoting, sliding, or revolving panels and fixed panels. A window consists of a lining and one or several panels.
labels.ifccls_IfcAirTerminal: Salur keluar atau salur masuk udara, seperti grill atau pemancar udara, tempat udara bersaluran masuk atau keluar dari sesebuah bilik.
labels.ifccls_IfcAlarm: Alat yang memberi amaran kepada orang tentang kebakaran atau bahaya lain melalui bunyi atau cahaya, seperti loceng, siren atau lampu isyarat.
labels.ifccls_IfcBeam: Anggota struktur mendatar atau hampir mendatar yang menanggung beban merentasi satu rentang, biasanya ke atas tiang atau dinding.
labels.ifccls_IfcBuildingElementPart: Satu bahagian bagi elemen bangunan yang lebih besar, seperti satu lapisan atau kepingan tunggal sesuatu dinding atau papak, yang disimpan sebagai objek tersendiri.
labels.ifccls_IfcBuildingElementProxy: Elemen yang tidak diberi jenis khusus oleh model sumber, maka ia disimpan sebagai elemen bangunan umum.
labels.ifccls_IfcCableCarrierFitting: Kelengkapan yang menyambung, membengkok atau mencabangkan dulang kabel, tangga kabel atau trunking.
labels.ifccls_IfcCableCarrierSegment: Larian lurus dulang kabel, tangga kabel, trunking atau konduit yang membawa dan melindungi kabel.
labels.ifccls_IfcColumn: Anggota struktur menegak yang menyalurkan beban daripada rasuk dan papak ke bawah menuju asas.
labels.ifccls_IfcController: Alat yang mengawal sesuatu sistem berdasarkan isyarat yang diterimanya, seperti termostat, pemasa atau panel kawalan.
labels.ifccls_IfcCovering: Lapisan penamat di atas elemen lain, seperti siling, penamat lantai, pelapis atau penebat.
labels.ifccls_IfcCurtainWall: Dinding luar yang terdiri daripada panel, selalunya kaca, digantung pada rangka yang dipasang pada bangunan; ia tidak menanggung beban lantai.
labels.ifccls_IfcDistributionControlElement: Alat kawalan atau pengesan bagi sistem bangunan, seperti penderia atau penggerak, tanpa jenis yang lebih khusus.
labels.ifccls_IfcDoor: Pintu: daun pintu dalam bingkainya yang dibuka untuk membenarkan orang lalu melalui dinding atau sekatan.
labels.ifccls_IfcDuctFitting: Bahagian saluran yang menyambung, membengkok, mencabangkan atau menukar saiz saluran udara.
labels.ifccls_IfcDuctSegment: Satu panjang lurus saluran udara yang membawa udara antara peralatan dan bilik.
labels.ifccls_IfcElectricAppliance: Perkakas elektrik yang disambungkan kepada bekalan bangunan, seperti peti sejuk, ketuhar atau pemanas air.
labels.ifccls_IfcEnergyConversionDevice: Peralatan yang menukar satu bentuk tenaga kepada bentuk lain, seperti dandang, penyejuk atau transformer, tanpa jenis yang lebih khusus.
labels.ifccls_IfcFireSuppressionTerminal: Salur keluar pemadaman kebakaran, seperti kepala penyiram, gelendong hos atau hidran kebakaran.
labels.ifccls_IfcFlowController: Alat yang mengawal aliran dalam paip, saluran atau litar, seperti injap, damper atau suis, tanpa jenis yang lebih khusus.
labels.ifccls_IfcFlowFitting: Kelengkapan yang menyambung, membengkok atau mencabangkan paip, saluran atau larian kabel, tanpa jenis yang lebih khusus.
labels.ifccls_IfcFlowInstrumentType: Jenis tolok atau meter, seperti tolok tekanan, termometer atau voltmeter.
labels.ifccls_IfcFlowMovingDevice: Peralatan yang menggerakkan bendalir, seperti pam, kipas atau pemampat, tanpa jenis yang lebih khusus.
labels.ifccls_IfcFlowSegment: Larian lurus paip, saluran atau pembawa kabel, tanpa jenis yang lebih khusus.
labels.ifccls_IfcFlowStorageDevice: Peralatan yang menyimpan bendalir atau tenaga, seperti tangki atau bateri, tanpa jenis yang lebih khusus.
labels.ifccls_IfcFlowTerminal: Titik hujung tempat sesuatu sistem menyalurkan perkhidmatan kepada bilik atau orang, seperti pili, lampu atau soket, tanpa jenis yang lebih khusus.
labels.ifccls_IfcFlowTreatmentDevice: Peralatan yang membersihkan atau merawat bendalir, seperti penapis atau pemisah, tanpa jenis yang lebih khusus.
labels.ifccls_IfcFooting: Elemen asas, seperti tapak pad atau tapak jalur, yang menyebarkan beban bangunan ke dalam tanah.
labels.ifccls_IfcFurnishingElement: Sekeping perabot atau peralatan yang diletakkan dalam bilik, tanpa jenis yang lebih khusus.
labels.ifccls_IfcFurniture: Perabot, seperti meja, kerusi, katil, meja tulis atau kabinet.
labels.ifccls_IfcLightFixture: Kelengkapan lampu (luminair) yang memegang lampu dan menerangi sesuatu ruang.
labels.ifccls_IfcMember: Kepingan struktur atau kerangka yang bukan rasuk atau tiang utama, seperti penyokong, stud, mulion atau purlin.
labels.ifccls_IfcOpeningElement: Lompang yang dipotong pada dinding, papak atau elemen lain, biasanya untuk pintu atau tingkap atau untuk laluan perkhidmatan.
labels.ifccls_IfcPipeFitting: Bahagian paip yang menyambung, membengkok, mencabangkan atau menukar saiz paip, seperti siku, tee atau penurun.
labels.ifccls_IfcPipeSegment: Satu panjang lurus paip yang membawa air, gas atau bendalir lain.
labels.ifccls_IfcPlate: Elemen nipis dan rata, seperti plat keluli atau panel kaca pada dinding tirai.
labels.ifccls_IfcRailing: Rel pengadang, pemegang tangan atau balustrad, contohnya di sepanjang tangga, tanjakan atau tepi balkoni.
labels.ifccls_IfcRamp: Laluan pejalan kaki yang condong menghubungkan dua aras, terdiri daripada satu atau lebih larian tanjakan dan pelantar.
labels.ifccls_IfcRampFlight: Satu larian condong sesebuah tanjakan antara dua pelantar.
labels.ifccls_IfcReinforcingBar: Bar tetulang keluli (rebar) yang diletakkan dalam konkrit untuk menanggung tegangan.
labels.ifccls_IfcRoof: Bumbung: penutup atas sesebuah bangunan, terdiri daripada papak, rasuk dan bahagian lain.
labels.ifccls_IfcSensorType: Jenis penderia yang mengesan sesuatu keadaan, seperti asap, haba, suhu atau pergerakan.
labels.ifccls_IfcSlab: Elemen rata yang mendatar atau hampir mendatar, seperti lantai, papak bumbung atau pelantar, biasanya daripada konkrit.
labels.ifccls_IfcStair: Tangga yang menghubungkan dua aras, terdiri daripada satu atau lebih larian dan pelantar.
labels.ifccls_IfcStairFlight: Satu larian anak tangga sesebuah tangga antara dua pelantar.
labels.ifccls_IfcSwitchingDevice: Alat yang menghidupkan atau mematikan litar elektrik, seperti suis, pemutus litar atau kontaktor.
labels.ifccls_IfcSystemFurnitureElement: Bahagian sistem perabot pejabat modular, seperti panel skrin, permukaan kerja atau unit simpanan.
labels.ifccls_IfcTransportElement: Peralatan yang menggerakkan orang atau barang, seperti lif, eskalator atau laluan bergerak.
labels.ifccls_IfcValve: Injap yang membuka, menutup atau mengawal aliran dalam paip.
labels.ifccls_IfcWall: Dinding: elemen menegak yang membahagikan atau mengelilingi ruang; ia mungkin atau mungkin tidak menanggung beban.
labels.ifccls_IfcWallStandardCase: Dinding dengan ketebalan sekata sepanjang panjangnya (nama IFC yang lebih lama, kini dianggap sebagai dinding biasa).
labels.ifccls_IfcWindow: Tingkap: bukaan berbingkai, biasanya berkaca, yang membenarkan cahaya dan udara masuk.
labels.ui_cls_no_official: Bahasa Inggeris: tiada terjemahan rasmi dalam bahasa anda
labels.ifcdef_IfcFlowInstrumentType: A flow instrument reads and displays the value of a particular property of a system at a point, or displays the difference in the value of a property between two points.
labels.ifcdef_IfcSensorType: A sensor is a device that measures a physical quantity and converts it into a signal which can be read by an observer or by an instrument.
